sources.title: GitHub - Lothnic/Themis
sources.snippet: Themis is a planned text-only, general-purpose decision model built from Qwen/Qwen3.5-.8B. It takes a case, runtime-defined questions, and allowed answers, and returns probabilities for each decision.

sources.title: Themis AI — Make reliable decisions with AI
sources.snippet: Make reliable decisions with AI. AI errors are costly. Checking every output is costly too. Themis helps you identify which predictions and proposed actions need attention, so you can automate more work and focus verification, expert review and model improvement where they matter.
